$comment: Relays the nightly session-e2e matrix runs against, and the interop report lists. To add yours, open a PR adding an entry. experimental: reported, but does not fail the run. knownIssues: relay-side gaps; the report labels a failed test with one when its file matches a tests entry and its error or log contains match (plain text).

knownIssues.summary: Its FETCH Object ID Delta still uses the draft-22 rule; draft-23 makes each ID the prior ID + delta + 2 within a group (#2006), so the IDs come out shifted.
It refuses a PUBLISH_NAMESPACE for a namespace the same session already sent a PUBLISH under ("Namespace already published").
